text: Chioma starts at the council planning office Monday at 9. Nervous about the commute more than the job tbh. Text her Monday evening to see how day one went.
Luca's a massive Torino fan, has been since his nonno took him as a kid. Season ticket, the lot. Hates Juve with a passion.
zainab got the promotion!! team lead from jan. her sister Anika already planning drinks for it, fri 7ish at the Crown
Quick one. Tanvi's retiring end of November after 31 years at the hospital lab. Leaving do is the 28th at half 6. Chip in for the card, Reggie's collecting.
Meera mentioned Louis has his first day at the bakery tomorrow morning, 5am start, poor lad. He's really anxious about it. Message him the day before... well tonight then, good luck.
Liam into warhammer in a big way now, painting a whole Ultramarines army. Said he'd kill for a decent airbrush. Birthday's in March, note for later.
Tariq and Claire are off to Lisbon on the 3rd, back the following Thursday. I'm feeding their cat Biscuit while they're gone.

So Arjun was telling me his dad finally retires on Friday. Big lunch for him at the golf club Saturday at 1. Arjun's doing a speech and he's dreading it, he hates public speaking. Should text him Saturday morning, just something encouraging. Also his mum's knee op got moved to the 14th, ask how that went the week after.
Esme's quitting the agency. Handed notice in today, last day 15th Nov. Doesn't have anything lined up yet which is very unlike her.
Sara knits. Like properly knits, jumpers with colourwork, sells a few on Etsy. Wants to learn brioche stitch next.
pick up dry cleaning thurs before 6, post office for the passport form
Valentina said Milan got into the Hallé youth orchestra! Second violin. First rehearsal is next Tuesday after school.

Mateo had his interview at the bank this morning. Thinks it went okay but they asked loads about Excel which he's a bit rubbish at. Hear back within a week apparently. His girlfriend Camila reckons he's got it. If he does, he'd start in January, which works because his lease ends then anyway. He was more excited about the work football team than the job itself, typical Mateo.
Remind me to ring Jaya on Thursday afternoon, her first week as a deputy head has been a nightmare and she sounded exhausted.
Omar is Aditi's cousin, not her brother. Works for Rolls-Royce in Derby, engines. Plays cricket every Sunday in summer.
Camila's housewarming was meant to be this Saturday but it's off, the boiler packed in. Rescheduled for the 15th at 7, same place.

Voice note. Um, so Deepa's son Cem, is it Cem? yeah Cem, he's starting his apprenticeship at the garage on the 2nd. She's proud but also worried because he's never had a proper job. Deepa wants me to pop by the week after to hear how he's getting on, so, yeah, do that.
Siobhan's mum passed last week. Funeral's Wednesday at 11 in Galway, she's flying out the day before. Don't forget to send flowers to the house and check in with her the next day.
Lin is obsessed with Hollow Knight right now. Speedrunning it apparently. Silksong too. Also does bouldering Tuesdays.
Owen and Grace have been married ten years on the 22nd. Doing a weekend in the Lakes. Grace hinted she'd love a print of Buttermere for the hallway, wonder if Owen picked that up.

joe left his job. well, made redundant. found out tues. says he's fine but clearly isn't. kids still don't know. his wife Esme just went back to work part time too so money's tight. he's been applying for stuff all week, has a call with a recruiter wed at 4. check in with him end of the week, maybe take him for a pint

Kavya passed her driving test!!! Third attempt. Celebrating Sunday lunch at her nan's. She failed the first two on roundabouts, of all things, so she was a nervous wreck this morning. Her dad's already looking at a little Fiat for her. She wants to drive up to see Owen in Leeds the weekend after, bless.
Must email Chiara back about the Shah wedding seating plan by Friday noon.
Reggie Hughes, new neighbour at 14. Retired postman. Grows dahlias and enters them in the village show every August. Has a greyhound called Nell.

Had coffee w Luca + Chiara. Luca's moving to Manchester in Jan for the new role at the BBC, starts the 8th. Chiara staying put for now, she's mid-PhD. They seem ok about the distance. Ask Luca the week after he starts how the flat hunt went.
Zainab says her brother Tariq is retiring from the army after 22 years. Passing out thing at Catterick on the 30th at 10am, whole family's going. She's going to be a wreck.
Anika plays bass in a covers band, Fleetwood Mac and Talking Heads mostly. Gig at the Fox and Hounds this Saturday 9pm. I'm going.
Gym at 7 tomorrow, then dentist at 10:15. Book car service for next week.
Need to get something for Meera, she's leaving the firm on the 12th after eight years. She mentioned wanting to get into pottery so maybe a taster class voucher.
Louis Ahmed (Lou) is the new starter on our team from Monday. Ex-Deloitte, supports Arsenal, lives in Walthamstow with his partner and their two kids.
Tanvi's daughter Esme has her uni interview at Oxford on 9 Dec at 2:30. Tanvi more nervous than Esme is honestly. Message Esme good luck that morning and Tanvi afterwards.
Claire's had a rough week. Her probation review got pushed back again and her manager keeps moving goalposts. Says she's thinking of leaving. Coffee with her soon, maybe Thursday lunchtime.
arjun got made partner!! announced this morning. celebratory dinner next fri, his wife Deepa's booking somewhere

So talking to Grace after book club. She's reading everything by Ishiguro in order, on The Unconsoled now and hating it. Her husband Owen is more of a sci fi guy, Le Guin, Banks, that sort of thing. Christmas idea: the new Culture box set for him, she said he's been eyeing it.
Mrs Popescu from next door told me her grandson Milan is starting at the Royal Ballet School in September. Boarding. She's thrilled but a bit sad.
I'm driving Kavya to the airport on the 18th at 6am. She's off to Tokyo for a month, new contract at the Ito studio.
Siobhan's hen do is cancelled, she and the fiance split up last month. Didn't want to talk about it. Check in on her at the weekend.
Omar's last day at the school was today, 34 years teaching geography. Kids made him a massive card. His wife Lin has planned a surprise party Saturday at 8, don't mention it to him!
Chioma's knitting group meets Wednesdays at the library. She's into crochet amigurumi too, makes little frogs.
tariq mentioned uncle reggie's heart op is thursday morning. tariq's driving him in, staying overnight. text tariq thurs eve for news
Nothing major. Caught up with Sara at the school gate, both knackered, agreed to do a proper catch up after half term.
Liam's partner Aditi is expecting! Due in April. They found out the week before his new job started, mad timing. Should send them something small.
Dr Shah, Valentina's consultant, wants to see her again two weeks after the scan on the 4th. She's worried but trying not to show it.
Jaya's brother Joe has his first gig with the new band on the 25th at the Cluny, 8pm. Jaya's going, asked if I'd come too. Find out how it went if I can't make it.
Cem is learning the saz, Turkish lute thing. Takes lessons online from a guy in Izmir. Also big Fenerbahçe fan.

Big catch up with Camila tonight. Her promotion to head of ops finally came through, starts officially on the 1st but she's been doing the job since summer. Her mum's not well though, scans next week, and her brother Mateo's flying in from Bogotá on Monday to help. She's juggling a lot. Remind me to call her Tuesday evening and maybe take dinner round the weekend after.
Owen started at the fire service training centre this morning. 12 week course, passing out ceremony in Feb.
Deepa's dog Pepper had surgery on her leg yesterday, home now with the cone. Deepa's shattered after being up all night.
Kavya's boss Siobhan MacDonald is leaving end of month. Kavya might go for her job. Interview probably mid-November. Wish her luck nearer the time.
Esme and Louis are getting married!! Engaged on Saturday on top of Snowdon. Wedding probably summer 2028. Card.
Renew railcard. Cancel the gym trial before the 30th or they'll charge me.
Zainab follows Formula 1 religiously, Ferrari since Schumacher. Going to Silverstone next July with her dad, already bought the tickets.

Milan's first day at the new firm was Monday. Said it went fine, his manager Grace seems nice, but the commute is 90 mins each way. Follow up in a couple of weeks re how he's settling. He's thinking of getting a flat closer in the spring, maybe near Grace actually, she's in Didsbury. Also his sister Kavya is visiting the weekend after next, so not that weekend.
Tanvi is in a choir, alto. Big concert at the cathedral on 14 Dec at 7:30, the Messiah. I've already got tickets.
Meera's sister Chiara is having a baby shower on Sunday 2pm. I said I'd bring cake. Don't forget the gift bag too.
Chat with Reggie: he's been at Nissan 19 years, line supervisor. Hinted he'd take early retirement if they offered. Mad on fishing, carp mainly.
Anika's results day for her accountancy exams is 10th Jan. Then she goes for the promotion the week after if she passes. Ask how it went that afternoon.
Lunch with Arjun. Mostly talked about his allotment, he's growing chillies, nine varieties. Nothing else.

so jaya's mum and dad are both retiring next spring, dad in march mum in may, and they're moving to Portugal in the summer. jaya not thrilled, she's relying on them for childcare for her twins. she said her husband Mateo thinks it's fine. she's stressed. ring her this weekend, maybe sunday afternoon

Valentina rang. Her new job at the museum starts on the 6th but she has induction the Friday before at 10, and then a team away day the week after. Wants a lift to the station that first morning. Fine, I'll take her.
